messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on strategy + roadmap. i'll hang here for 25m to take sharp q's about mission, market positioning, and competitor calls. keep it curt. :wave:
Devon (Eng): when we say 'graceful degradation' what are the concrete fallbacks? model downgrade? region failover?
Chris (VP Product): layered fallbacks: 1) lightweight model variant (quantized or smaller), 2) route to dedicated pool if hosted capacity saturated, 3) region failover for critical apps. automatic, policy-driven.
Sana (Sales): short battleground line for prospects who ask "why not just use cloud endpoints?"
Maya (Head of Strategy): use: "Redwood makes serving predictable at scale — real SLAs, rollout controls, and cost visibility teams need to ship LLM features without building infra."
Devon (Eng): roadmap question: will Optimize's recommendations be automated or advisory at launch?
Chris (VP Product): advisory first (explainable suggestions), automated actions later behind an opt-in. we need telemetry and guardrails before auto-tuning.
Sana (Sales): can customers bring their finetuned models to Hosted? we get this a lot.
Ava (CEO): Hosted: enterprise-only model uploads with security review. Dedicated/Private: full customer models supported, with version pinning and canary rollouts.
Devon (Eng): quick: do we commit to public perf benchmarks for common models?
Maya (Head of Strategy): yes — transparency helps adoption. publish curated benchmark suite showing latency, throughput, and unit cost tradeoffs.
AnnounceBot: all-hands summary uploaded to docs at 1766112400 by AnnounceBot
Sana (Sales): one-liner for the pitch deck that's non-technical?
Maya (Head of Strategy): "Redwood Inference: the production platform that helps teams run LLMs with dependable performance, lower costs, and enterprise controls across any environment." short and customer-facing.
Ava (CEO): i'll put Maya's line into the marketing repo and share a short battlecard. thanks all 64b. if you want a deeper competitor briefing, ping Maya + Chris to book time.
